text.subtitle.00.0: Goldwood, Th' Forest Sea. Yo ho!
text.subtitle.00.2: from Cap'n Mizar an' his black-hearted Bilge rats. Shiver me timbers!
text.subtitle.01.1: These will increase yer grog. Arr, matey!
text.subtitle.02.1: Collect them t' increase yer supplies. Blow me down!
text.subtitle.03.0: Beware o' Mizar's Soldier Bilge rats.
text.subtitle.03.1: They remain on Goldwood in shipshape numbers. Arr!
text.subtitle.03.2: Though weak, they often travel in groups.
text.subtitle.04.0: Don't be caught off guard by Sniper Bilge rats. Yo ho!
text.subtitle.04.1: They use th' treetops as ambush points.
text.subtitle.04.2: Pick them off usin' manual targetin'. Shiver me timbers!
text.subtitle.05.0: Across th' voyage ye will plunder th' Tribals.
text.subtitle.05.1: This bear-like race has been enslaved by Cap'n Mizar. Arr, matey!
text.subtitle.05.2: Free as many Tribals as ye possibly can.
text.subtitle.06.0: When ye have completed yer objectives,
text.subtitle.06.1: plunder th' take-off pad, where yer galleon awaits.
text.subtitle.06.2: Ye be now one step closer t' Mizar's lair. Arr!
text.subtitle.07.0: Thanks, Juno! I knew I could count on ye.
text.subtitle.07.1: So much fer this place bein' deserted... Yo ho!
text.subtitle.07.2: Anyway, I promised t' go after Lupus.
text.subtitle.15.0: Cap'n Mizar knows we're gunnin' fer him,
text.subtitle.16.0: so things got pretty heated back thar. Yo ho!
text.subtitle.17.0: Th' Spawnship... spy at that security.
text.subtitle.18.0: There's nay way we'll both make it on board. Shiver me timbers!
text.subtitle.21.0: Nay time t' argue, boy, ye be faster.
text.subtitle.21.1: Go! Head fer one o' those cargo ramps! Blow me down!
text.subtitle.21.2: Don't worry, I'll cover ye. Make haste!
text.subtitle.22.0: We overheard some guards when we arrived,
text.subtitle.22.1: which told us all about th' Bilge rat generator.
text.subtitle.23.0: 'tis part o' somethin' called th' Spawnship,
text.subtitle.23.1: currently docked at Ichor Military Base.
text.subtitle.24.0: Then I got careless, but Lupus escaped... Shiver me timbers!
text.subtitle.24.1: He couldn't free me, so I told him t' go on.
text.subtitle.24.2: I just hope we haven't missed our chance. Arr, matey!
text.subtitle.25.0: I'll hitch a ride on th' warship Sekhmet,
text.subtitle.25.1: that should get me through local defenses. Blow me down!
text.subtitle.26.0: Ye stick t' this route, 'tis not far now.
text.subtitle.26.1: We'll meet up wit' ye at Mizar's Palace... Arr!
text.subtitle.26.2: Thanks again, Juno. An' fine luck!
text.subtitle.27.0: Spy, I told ye t' let me drive... Yo ho!
text.subtitle.27.2: Ye two stay here an' lend a hook Jeff fix it up. Shiver me timbers!
text.subtitle.27.3: I'll go an' scout out th' surface.
text.subtitle.27.4: Cap'n Mizar can't be too far away... Arr, matey!
text.subtitle.28.0: What th' - Barry? What be ye doin'?
text.subtitle.29.0: Ye know him? Blow me down!
text.subtitle.30.0: He's... me brother. But he left th' colony -
text.subtitle.31.0: I had t' leave, Jeff. I couldn't stand it. Arr!
text.subtitle.31.1: It were always ye: ye wit' th' powers,
text.subtitle.31.2: ye next in line t' be King, me wit' nothin'. Yo ho!
text.subtitle.31.3: I couldn't live in yer shadow any longer.
text.subtitle.31.4: I had t' have me share o' th' limelight... Shiver me timbers!
text.subtitle.31.5: Which be why I created Cap'n Mizar.
text.subtitle.32.0: I can't believe it. Me own brother. Arr, matey!
text.subtitle.32.1: You'd put so much at risk?
text.subtitle.33.0: I'm sorry, Jeff. I marooned control. Blow me down!
text.subtitle.33.1: I never intended things t' go this far.
text.subtitle.34.0: Th' Federation will want t' know... Arr!
text.subtitle.35.0: Nay, Juno. This be our business.
text.subtitle.35.1: We'll take it back t' Goldwood wit' us. Yo ho!
text.subtitle.36.0: Ye concentrate on stoppin' th' asteroid.
text.subtitle.37.0: This thing's loaded wit' explosives. Shiver me timbers!
text.subtitle.37.1: As Cap'n Mizar, I'd have sunk it afore impact:
text.subtitle.37.2: But now we'll never reach th' core in time! Arr, matey!
text.subtitle.38.0: Ahem. If I may be o' assistance?
text.subtitle.38.1: Thar be plenty o' fissures wide enough... Blow me down!
text.subtitle.38.2: I can get t' th' core. 'tis yer only chance.
text.subtitle.39.0: Floyd... ye don't have t' do this. Arr!
text.subtitle.40.0: Maybe, not so long ago, I wouldn't have.
text.subtitle.40.1: Now I know that 'tis th' right thin' t' do. Yo ho!
text.subtitle.40.2: Time's runnin' short. Load me up.
text.subtitle.40.3: It has been an honor t' know ye, Jet Force. Shiver me timbers!
text.subtitle.41.0: Ye DARE defy th' rule o' Cap'n Mizar?
text.subtitle.41.1: Insolent Earth scum! Ye will regret this... Arr, matey!
text.subtitle.41.2: As ye watch yer homeworld torn asunder!
text.subtitle.42.0: Me hearties, how can we ever thank ye? Blow me down!
text.subtitle.42.1: Many would simply have ignored our plight.
text.subtitle.42.2: An' yet yer only reward... Arr!
text.subtitle.42.3: be this sudden threat t' yer own sea.
text.subtitle.43.0: Th' asteroid be headin' straight fer Earth! Yo ho!
text.subtitle.43.1: If ye don't act t' avert this crisis,
text.subtitle.43.2: th' collision may well rid us o' Cap'n Mizar,
text.subtitle.43.3: but at a terrible cost t' yer people.
text.subtitle.43.4: Worse still, yer Jet Force ships--
text.subtitle.43.5: they just won't get ye thar in time.
text.subtitle.44.0: We have a galleon that may serve yer needs,
text.subtitle.44.2: Th' galleon belonged t' our distant ancestors. Arr!
text.subtitle.44.3: It brought them t' this galaxy centuries ago.
text.subtitle.44.4: Since then, twelve parts have gone missin',
text.subtitle.44.5: scattered far an' wide across nearby worlds.
text.subtitle.44.6: Th' final piece I myself still own... Shiver me timbers!
text.subtitle.45.0: 'tis yers when all th' Tribals be free.
text.subtitle.45.1: Sorry t' be so mercenary about it. Arr, matey!
text.subtitle.45.2: If ye can collect all twelve parts,
text.subtitle.45.3: our flagship may take flight once again! Blow me down!
text.subtitle.45.4: Th' Pause Menu will record yer progress.
text.subtitle.46.1: we can upgrade yer armour too.
text.subtitle.46.2: We'll even throw in a Jet Pack attachment,
text.subtitle.46.3: which ye can charge on designated pads.
text.subtitle.46.4: Now, enough talk... ye have much t' do. Shiver me timbers!
text.subtitle.46.5: Th' mighty best o' luck t' ye all!
text.subtitle.47.0: Ye've taken th' wrong route. Arr, matey!
text.subtitle.48.0: Ye've taken th' wrong route. Blow me down!
text.subtitle.49.0: Ye've taken th' wrong route. Arr!
text.hint.001.1: We've been expectin' ye--Vela an' Lupus came chargin' through not so long ago. Feisty pair, ain't they? Arr, matey!
text.hint.001.3: Not that th' Union's much use. Without backup, th' Tribals couldn't hope t' fend off Mizar's raiders. Blow me down!
text.hint.001.4: Ye'll plunder th' Tribal King in his hut just this way. I promised I'd send ye t' him when ye arrived.
text.hint.001.5: Follow th' green hatch symbols t' move forward, or th' red ones if ye want t' retrace yer steps. Arr!
text.hint.001.6: But I've rambled on long enough... you'd better make haste if ye be hopin' t' catch up wit' yer teammates.
text.hint.002.0: Juno... thank ye fer comin'. Yo ho!
text.hint.002.1: A dark day be upon us when King Jeff o' th' Tribals be powerless t' save his own people. We can only trust in Jet Force Gemini t' thwart Mizar's plans fer domination.
text.hint.002.2: Tell ye what, it gets a bit depressin', all this King business. Shiver me timbers!
text.hint.002.3: Still, must keep a stiff upper lip. If ye could rescue as many Tribals as possible in between slaughterin' Bilge rats, I'd be most grateful.
text.hint.002.4: Let me know if ye spy me brother, too. He's been missin' fer some time. Arr, matey!
text.hint.002.5: I hope t' return these favors later, but at th' moment I can do little--except perhaps conjure up a timeloop t' replay th' invasion...
text.hint.003.0: Don't be too hasty, Juno. Goldwood ain't th' place it once were: ye can't risk goin' in unprepared. Blow me down!
text.hint.003.1: Keep an eye on yer Pistol's charge gauge, as ye'll need all th' firepower ye can muster.
text.hint.003.2: Fer a start, Life Force hatches such as this one won't open while Cap'n Mizar has troops active in th' area. Arr!
text.hint.003.3: Ye must sink all nearby scallywags t' progress. Learn t' use th' R Button fer manual targetin'.
text.hint.003.4: Also, take note o' these Region Markers. A green one lets ye know that ye be about t' enter a new Region, a red one shows that ye be leavin' a Region, an' both together mean that ye be movin' from one Region directly into another. Yo ho!
text.hint.003.5: That's about all I can tell ye. Get through this first hatch an' ye be as ready as ye'll ever be. Fine luck, Juno.
text.hint.003.6: Listen t' th' briefin' afore ye start, an' be careful... Shiver me timbers!
text.hint.004.0: Listen t' th' briefin' afore ye start, an' be careful...
text.hint.005.1: I move pretty swift, I know. It just occurred t' me that ye might be curious about this hatch: 'tis actually a trainin' area fer Mizar's Airborne Squadrons.
text.hint.005.2: However, I'm afraid 'tis out o' me jurisdiction, so don't expect t' get in thar unless ye have contacts. Blow me down!
text.hint.005.3: Other hatches require heavy firepower t' open--Mizar's security ain't subtle.
text.hint.005.4: Oh, an' afore I forget, Vela left this skeleton key fer ye when she passed through. Where were she headed? Hmmmm... thar were some mention o' scavengin' fer supplies on th' old SS Anubis. Better get movin', Juno! Arr!
text.hint.006.0: I'm afraid I've more or less done all I can. You'd better take it from here.
text.hint.007.0: Vela, thank goodness ye be safe!
text.hint.007.1: But where be me manners? Call me Midge. I work at th' Union wit' Magnus. They sent me down here t' negotiate wit' Cap'n Mizar, though I told them it'd be a waste o' time... Shiver me timbers!
text.hint.007.2: Big ugly brute broke three o' me fingernails. But at least we stand a fightin' chance wit' th' full Gemini team on th' loose again!
text.hint.007.3: If we wait fer th' Union t' make a stand, it'll be too late... Arr, matey!
text.hint.007.4: We're relyin' on ye now. Just be mighty careful aboard Sekhmet* th' raids on Goldwood were launched from this galleon, so 'tis crawlin' wit' nasty Bilge rats an' their Tribal prisoners. I'd free them myself, but I'm allergic t' violence.
text.hint.007.5: Better make haste, too, I saw one o' th' Amazin' Minin' Mole Brothers arrive earlier. They've got nay qualms about usin' th' Tribals as slave labor, so I wouldn't be surprised if they were here t' buy in bulk. Blow me down!
text.hint.007.6: Well, I'll let ye get on wit' it. Though I suggest ye abandon this old crate afore it reaches th' Military Base, or ye don't stand a chance o' gettin' off undetected. An' when ye spy that Cap'n Mizar, give him a slap from me...
text.hint.008.0: Get a move on, old girl, there's not a moment t' lose... Arr!
text.hint.009.0: Juno, Juno--ye be here at last.
text.hint.009.1: I'm afraid there's some scurvy news. I came as smartly as I could when I heard that some o' Mizar's heavies had reoccupied th' Anubis, but it seems I were too late t' warn Vela... Yo ho!
text.hint.010.0: Be everythin' okay? I trust ye be not forgettin' about Vela...
text.hint.010.1: By th' way, I almost forgot: there's a chest worth investigatin' on th' ledge up thar, if ye haven't emptied it already. Shiver me timbers!
text.hint.011.0: Wow... looks like everything's still really uncool an' heavy.
text.hint.011.1: Name's Gimlet--those little furry guys used t' let me live out here in peace. I'm not used t' all this freaky technofear magic stuff. Arr, matey!
text.hint.011.2: One minute everything's groovy, th' next Mizar's goons come pilin' in, then Jeff appears, goes freaky an' turns everythin' pear-shaped...
text.hint.011.3: I'm stayin' in here nursin' me karma until things be cool again. Blow me down!
text.hint.011.4: But listen, man, I've got a bit o' a problem. In all th' confusion, one o' those insect guys stole me pants an' threw them up a tree...
text.hint.011.5: Could ye spy if they're still around? I've only got th' one pair. Arr!
text.hint.012.1: Er, right. I'll be off then... Yo ho!
text.hint.013.0: Oh wow! They're okay! Press th' A Button t' give them t' me, or press th' B Button if, like, ye want t' keep them or somethin'.
text.hint.014.0: What's th' deal, man? Be ye lookin' fer me pants or ain't ye? Don't be so cruel. Shiver me timbers!
text.hint.014.1: They're stylish brown thermals designed t' keep out scurvy vibes. Ye'll know them if ye spy them.
text.hint.015.0: Ye don't know how grateful I be--this cold wind's been killin' me. Arr, matey!
text.hint.015.1: Let's spy what I can give ye... oh yeah, this crowbar's handy fer takin' out those heavy trapdoors, nay problem. An' hey, thanks, man.
text.hint.016.0: Ahhhh. Me yin an' yang be warmin' up nicely. Blow me down!
text.hint.017.0: Awright tosh? Diamond Geezer, Mercenary Bot at yer service.
text.hint.017.1: Ye want grog, powder, dodgy motor, insurance job--talk t' me. Arr!
text.hint.017.2: So, what can I do ye fer? Ha. Ha.
text.hint.018.2: Get away from me, ye awful thin'. Shiver me timbers!
text.hint.019.1: Sorry pal, I'll be needin' five tokens from ye afore I can lend a hook ye out. Arr, matey!
text.hint.020.1: Sorry mate, give me ten tokens an' maybe I'll spy what I can do. Blow me down!
text.hint.021.1: That's put a bit o' color back in yer cheeks, eh? Arr!
text.hint.021.2: Now, maybe I can interest ye in one o' these lovely watches...
text.hint.022.1: Whoa! Careful where ye point that.
text.hint.022.2: Thought ye were after me wallet fer a minute thar. Shiver me timbers!
text.hint.024.0: Whoa! What's a pretty young thin' like ye doin' in a place like this? Arr, matey!
text.hint.024.1: 'tis gettin' mighty dangerous around here, ye know, an' I don't reckon a sweet little lady such as yerself should be... oh. Big guns. I spy.
text.hint.024.2: Um, let's start again. Th' name's Fishface--me less handsome brothers an' I run a minin' company, Amazin' Minin' Mole Bros. Co. Plc. Ye've probably heard o' us...? Blow me down!
text.hint.024.3: Okay, sure, ye be new t' th' area.
text.hint.024.4: Anyway, I came here t' cut a deal wit' Cap'n Mizar, but it looks like he wants t' keep all those pesky little fleabag Tribals workin' fer him an' nay-one else. I swear, there's just nay talkin' t' that scumbag. Arr!
text.hint.024.5: We're goin' t' go out o' business. Th' only operation we have left be me brother's me own on Rith Essa.
text.hint.024.6: Better make me way back afore that one goes bust too... not much point hangin' around here, anyway. Yo ho!
text.hint.024.7: Hang on a minute--ye be one o' those crusadin' heroine types, ain't ye? Interestin'... maybe there's hope yet. Tell ye what, take this skeleton key, ye'll need it t' get into th' Dockin' Bay.
text.hint.024.8: I daresay we could equip ye wit' some better firepower, too, if ye really want t' rub that old tyrant up th' wrong way. Shiver me timbers!
text.hint.024.9: Ooh, I'm startin' t' spy forward t' this...
text.hint.024.10: Hook up wit' me again down on Cerulean, an' brin' some funds, eh? Go on, we need all th' cash we can get our hands on these days. Arr, matey!
text.hint.024.11: Fine luck t' ye, little lady. Us free thinkers need t' stick together.
text.hint.025.0: Spy ye on Cerulean, little lady... Blow me down!
text.hint.026.1: This were one o' th' last remainin' Tribal colonies. When I came t' tell me people that hope were at hand, only t' plunder Mizar's raiders here too, somethin' snapped an' I... just... Arr!
text.hint.026.2: I misused me powers, an' now I've helped Cap'n Mizar get just what he wants: death an' ruin.
text.hint.026.3: All that negative energy has sucked th' life from th' land as well as those Bilge rats. Yo ho!
text.hint.026.4: It'll take more than a few pistol blasts t' avast them now, I'm afraid--so th' least I can do be whip ye up somethin' stronger.
text.hint.026.5: What a nightmare... This place looks like Mizar's bathroom. Shiver me timbers!
text.hint.027.1: I must atone fer what I've done. Arr, matey!
text.hint.028.1: Would that be official Jet Force uniform? How interestin'. Cap'n Mizar claimed t' have sunk ye all. Blow me down!
text.hint.028.3: I were created along wit' many, many others t' form an elite Airborne Squadron, but recently Mizar's methods have led me t' doubt his cause. Such be th' drawbacks o' advanced AI, I'm afraid. Arr!
text.hint.028.4: T' cut a long story short, me misgivings were not appreciated an' th' Bilge rats decided t' make an example o' me. They scattered three o' me most vital components an' rather churlishly nailed me t' this post.
text.hint.028.5: Needless t' say, all previous loyalties have been compromised. If ye could possibly lend a hand in reassemblin' me, I guarantee ye me full services in restorin' justice where Cap'n Mizar has trodden. Um, all I need be those three missin' parts... Yo ho!
text.hint.028.6: Whether or not ye decide t' lend a hook, I'd be glad t' fill ye in on th' whole story behind this embarrassin' situation if ye have a spare moment.
text.hint.029.1: I don't suppose ye stumbled across any o' me missin' components durin' yer travels?
text.hint.030.0: Nay, ye don't appear t' have plundered them all yet. Arr, matey!
text.hint.030.1: I don't mean t' be a nuisance, but this be really mighty uncomfortable.
text.hint.031.0: I reckon I've plundered them all... Blow me down!
text.hint.031.1: How did ye end up like this again?
text.hint.032.0: Sorry about Flopsy. She gets bored bein' stuck way out here.
text.hint.032.1: Actually, I get pretty lonely myself sometimes. I, er... I don't suppose ye've got anythin' that could lend a hook take me mind off it all? Yo ho!
text.hint.032.2: I'd make it worth yer while, o' course. Nobody regrets doin' business wit' old Fernando. Let's say ye lend a hook me out, I'll let ye take a spy around th' me own, okay? Go on, 'tis really interestin'. Shipshape... er... historical value.
text.hint.032.3: An' if 'tis Tribals ye be after, ye can barely move fer th' little pests down thar. That's assumin' Flopsy hasn't sneaked in an' eaten some since I last looked. Shiver me timbers!
text.hint.032.4: So, what do ye say? Any offers?
text.hint.033.0: Well, maybe you'd like this... Arr, matey!
text.hint.034.0: What's that? A magazine? Certainly looks like it could prove a pleasant distraction durin' those solitary moments. Press th' A Button t' let me take a closer spy, or th' B Button t' keep a firm grip. Blow me down!
text.hint.035.0: Nah, ye don't have anythin' that tickles me fancy. I'm a literary kind o' guy, if that's any lend a hook.
text.hint.035.1: Call again if ye plunder somethin' I might like... an' try not t' get too badly chewed on yer way out. Arr!
text.hint.036.0: Oh, ye be a star. I can barely wait t' get started.
text.hint.036.1: Here's th' skeleton key t' th' me own, off ye go. Lock th' hatch on yer way out... Yo ho!
text.hint.037.0: Oi! Can't a mole get some privacy around here?
text.hint.038.0: Can I have th' Red Skeleton key? Shiver me timbers!
text.hint.038.1: Thanks fer th' advice, I'll spy ye later.
text.hint.039.0: Ahoy sailor, I'm Ivana Bear. 'tis all been kickin' off, hasn't it? Arr, matey!
text.hint.039.1: I thought I'd come an' hide out here until everythin' blows o'er. Thin' be, some o' these noisy Tribals had th' same idea. They keep wakin' me up...
text.hint.039.2: I'm startin' t' get grouchy now. What I'd give fer a pair o' earplugs. Blow me down!
text.hint.039.3: Hey, th' Anubis be a cargo galleon--if ye be headed that way, spy if ye can get that little Robot o' yers t' rustle up somethin' useful, okay?
text.hint.040.0: Would anythin' I'm carryin' lend a hook? Arr!
text.hint.040.1: I'll just go away... mighty quietly.
text.hint.041.0: Aha! Now those earplugs might just do th' trick. Could I have them? Yo ho!
text.hint.042.0: Ye be as scurvy as those Tribals. What have ye got that could lend a hook me get t' sleep? Nothin', that's what. Go on, scoot.
text.hint.043.0: Just th' ticket! Thanks. Now take this old bit o' junk an' give me some peace, okay? Shiver me timbers!
text.hint.045.1: Afore ye spins a piece o' some strange spacecraft.
text.hint.045.2: It looks a little old an' worn. Blow me down!
text.hint.046.0: This be terrible! Have ye seen it? That swine Cap'n Mizar be out fer revenge.
text.hint.046.1: Those asteroids be playin' havoc wit' Goldwood's orbit. We need t' fire up th' generator in th' Quarry an' blast them out o' th' sky... Arr!
text.hint.046.2: Trouble be, th' Tribals can't get it stoked wit' jewels smartly enough.
text.hint.046.3: If ye could blast some jewels into th' Vacuum at th' front, we might be able t' get enough power flowin' t' clear up this mess. Yo ho!
text.hint.046.4: We'd really appreciate yer lend a hook. Come an' let me know when ye've succeeded, as I've nay doubt ye will. All th' same, I reckon I'll just watch from in here...
text.hint.047.0: Remember, shoot th' jewels into th' Vacuum at th' front. Shiver me timbers!
text.hint.048.0: Fantastic! Another legendary victory fer Jet Force. Hurrah! Hurrah! Sorry. I'll calm down.
text.hint.048.1: Well, everything's back t' normal, thanks t' ye riskin' so much fer our little corner o' th' galaxy. Arr, matey!
text.hint.048.2: Old Cap'n Mizar must be really worried. 'tis th' first time any o' us have ever seen that tyrant on th' run.
text.hint.048.3: If ye want t' avast him fer fine afore he reaches Earth, ye'll probably need this. Please, take it. Blow me down!
text.hint.049.0: Thanks, Magnus! That's just what we've been lookin' fer.
text.hint.049.1: I must be on me way. Thank ye. Arr!
text.hint.050.0: Well, goodbye, me matey. An' fine luck.
text.hint.051.0: Congratulations! I were bouncin' around like a giddy fool back thar, watchin' old Cap'n Mizar take a poundin'. Ye Jet Force people certainly know how t' make a name fer yourselves, don't ye? Yo ho!
text.hint.051.2: Me, I'll just make myself comfy in this nice quiet spot until ye've finished th' job. Shiver me timbers!
text.hint.051.3: I'd better leave this wit' ye, though. Now get after that brute an' give him what fer!
text.hint.052.0: Thanks a lot, Midge. That'll certainly lend a hook! Arr, matey!
text.hint.053.0: Go on, go on, get after that big macho animal! Blow me down!
text.hint.054.0: Jet Force have saved th' galaxy an' plundered me pants. What a team.
text.hint.054.1: Here, I've got some groovy stuff fer ye. This be from that rusty old galleon o' Jeff's. Just don't ask me t' install it. Technofear, man. Arr!
text.hint.055.0: Thanks, Gimlet! Ye've been a big lend a hook.
text.hint.055.1: I should go now. Thanks, anyway. Yo ho!
text.hint.057.0: How can we ever thank ye? Many would have simply ignored our plight in th' face o' such odds... Shiver me timbers!
text.hint.057.1: An' yet yer only reward be th' sudden threat t' yer own sea by that coward Cap'n Mizar.
text.hint.057.2: Th' asteroid he's commandeered be headin' straight fer Earth. Arr, matey!
text.hint.057.3: If ye don't catch up wit' him in time, th' collision will certainly put an end t' his own life, but at a terrible cost t' yer people.
text.hint.057.4: Worse still, yer Jet Force patrol ships just ain't cut out fer such desperate work. Blow me down!
text.hint.057.5: We have a galleon that may serve yer needs, but thar be drawbacks.
text.hint.057.6: It be th' galleon our ancestors used t' reach this galaxy many centuries ago. Many o' its technologies have since been marooned in th' mists o' time... if we can locate th' missin' pieces, it will certainly carry ye t' a final confrontation wit' Cap'n Mizar. Arr!
text.hint.057.7: Twelve parts have gone missin' o'er th' years. Some have been hidden throughout th' galaxy, others hoarded by th' locals. Th' final piece I myself own, an' it will be yers as a reward when all th' captured Tribals be finally free.
text.hint.057.8: Sorry t' be so mercenary, but hey, times be rough... Yo ho!
text.hint.057.9: Anyway, enough talk. 'tis yer homeworld at stake! Be quick, plunder th' pieces an' we may be able t' avast that maniac fer fine.
text.hint.057.10: When ye have all twelve parts, brin' them back here an' we'll prepare this galleon fer its first voyage since th' dawn o' Goldwood. Shiver me timbers!
text.hint.057.11: Th' mighty best o' luck t' ye all!
text.hint.058.0: This be nay joke! Those galleon parts be vital! If ye need lend a hook, maybe Midge can lend a hand--ye'll plunder him back on th' SS Anubis. But ye may need t' use yer new Jet Pack, so get some practice in. Arr, matey!
text.hint.059.0: Ah, I spy ye've made a start. But thar be plenty more pieces t' plunder, an' th' clock be tickin'...
text.hint.060.0: Aye indeed! Ye be makin' real progress now. Just a few more pieces t' go. Blow me down!
text.hint.061.0: Our race has at last thrown off th' shackles o' Cap'n Mizar. Bravo!
text.hint.061.1: We will never forget Jet Force's inspirational heroics on this day. This prized relic from me ancestors' galleon be yers wit' all me gratitude. Arr!
text.hint.062.0: Wow, we're really grateful fer yer lend a hook. Thanks.
text.hint.062.1: I must be goin' now... Yo ho!
text.hint.063.0: At last, ye have all th' parts! An' not a moment too soon. Let's get t' work afore Cap'n Mizar can make his revenge complete...
text.hint.063.1: Mind if I tag along? Shiver me timbers!
text.hint.064.0: Well, ye took yer sweet time.
text.hint.064.1: Never mind, I've got th' merchandise right here. One Tri-Rocket Launcher, th' ultimate in portable bug busters* believe me, ye need this baby. Arr, matey!
text.hint.064.2: Yers fer only three pieces o' gold. I can't lend a hook myself, I'm virtually givin' them away.
text.hint.064.3: Well? What's th' matter? Don't say ye left yer purse at home. Blow me down!
text.hint.065.0: Not at all. Let's do business!
text.hint.065.1: Maybe I'll spy ye later... Arr!
text.hint.066.0: What? Be this a joke? Come back when ye have THREE pieces o' gold an' we'll talk.
text.hint.067.0: Haven't ye got a few things t' do? Yo ho!
text.hint.068.0: Ye guys be shipshape. Ye be doin' a bang-up job. Keep it up.
text.hint.069.0: Just between ye an' me, Furry, those Jet Force do-gooders want t' break up our little party. Shiver me timbers!
text.hint.069.1: Havin' Cap'n Mizar in power ain't such a scurvy idea, ye know. Could give us a lot o' room fer expansion.
text.hint.069.2: An' ye don't really mind workin' fer fine old Farmer, do ye? Come on, I'm not that scurvy. Anyway, ye like minin', I like doubloons--'tis th' perfect partnership. Arr, matey!
text.hint.069.3: Ye never know, I might even start payin' ye one day... but don't hold yer breath.
text.hint.069.4: Spy, this be what Jet Force will be after. If I give it t' ye, can ye go an' bury it somewhere? Blow me down!
text.hint.070.0: Sure thin' cap'n, I'll take care o' it.
text.hint.070.1: I need t' get back t' work... Arr!
text.hint.071.0: Lose th' hardware, Furry. I'm waitin'.
text.hint.072.0: Largin' it, big tunes on th' decks, ye know th' score. Yo ho!
text.hint.072.1: Give us a shout out an' I'll slip on some phat sounds.
text.hint.073.0: Got any funky disco? Shiver me timbers!
text.hint.073.1: Play me somethin' wit' a beat.
text.hint.073.4: What be ye talkin' about? I'm off. Blow me down!
text.hint.074.0: Big shout out t' th' ant wit' th' penchant fer funky disco.
text.hint.074.1: Respect t' th' six-legged MASSIVE. Arr!
text.hint.075.0: MC Fishface kickin' it wit' another large dance tune. Yo ho!
text.hint.075.2: LET ME HEAR SOME NOISE. Shiver me timbers!
text.hint.076.0: This one goes out t' th' bugs wit' beat.
text.hint.076.1: Insect MENTALISTS go crazy. Arr, matey!
text.hint.077.0: Let's slow things up wit' this smooth groove. Blow me down!
text.hint.077.1: Shout out t' th' Insect Posse.
text.hint.078.0: Whoa. Ye be that guy who doesn't like me music.
text.hint.078.1: Stay away from me if ye don't want th' bouncers t' get heavy. Yo ho!
text.hint.079.1: Ye've plundered th' Plasma Shotgun! Shiver me timbers!
text.hint.079.2: Remember t' hold down th' Z Button fer a more powerful burst.
text.hint.080.2: Be sure t' lock on afore firin'--they're much too useful t' waste... Blow me down!
text.hint.081.1: Ye've plundered th' Machine Pistol! Arr!
text.hint.081.2: Take care wit' its rapid but inaccurate firepower.
text.hint.082.2: Take care wit' its rapid but inaccurate firepower. Shiver me timbers!
text.hint.083.1: Plundered a stash o' Shuriken! Arr, matey!
text.hint.083.2: Don't forget t' retrieve as many as possible after use.
text.hint.084.1: Ye've plundered a stash o' Grenades!
text.hint.084.2: Try not t' get carried away an' blow yerself up. Arr!
text.hint.085.1: Ye've picked up th' Green Skeleton key. Yo ho!
text.hint.086.1: This literary masterpiece may prove useful t' some lonely soul. Shiver me timbers!
text.hint.087.1: Ye've plundered a stash o' handy Cluster Bombs! Arr, matey!
text.hint.087.2: Watch out fer that impact zone--'tis a killer.
text.hint.088.1: Ye've plundered a stash o' Flares! Nay, not th' 70s fashion accessory.
text.hint.088.2: Tap th' Z Button once t' ignite, an' again t' throw. Arr!
text.hint.089.1: Ye've plundered a stash o' handy Cluster Bombs! Yo ho!
text.hint.089.2: Watch out fer that impact zone--'tis a killer.
text.hint.090.2: Press th' Z Button once t' throw an' again t' detonate. Arr, matey!
text.hint.091.1: Ye've plundered some Timed Mines! Blow me down!
text.hint.091.2: Hold th' Z Button t' determine fuse length or just tap it fer proximity mode.
text.hint.092.1: Ye have plundered th' Fish Food.
text.hint.092.2: Guess what ye do wit' it. Yo ho!
text.hint.093.1: Ye've plundered th' Sniper Rifle! Shiver me timbers!
text.hint.093.2: Be sure t' make full use o' its extensive zoom function.
text.hint.094.2: Remember that berserk, flamin' Bilge rats can damage yer grog. Blow me down!
text.hint.095.2: Looks like ye be responsible fer its first field test...
text.hint.096.1: Ye've plundered th' Night Vision Goggles.
text.hint.096.2: Stand on th' relevant pad an' press th' A Button t' activate. Shiver me timbers!
text.hint.097.1: Ye be now in possession o' th' Blue Skeleton key. Arr, matey!
text.hint.097.2: Uncannily, this works wonders on hatches wit' blue locks.
text.hint.098.1: Ye be now in possession o' th' Red Skeleton key.
text.hint.098.2: Astonishingly, this can be used t' open hatches wit' red locks. Arr!
text.hint.099.1: Ye've plundered th' Tri-Rocket Launcher! Yo ho!
text.hint.099.2: Now ye can clear out those cramped corridors in style.
text.hint.100.1: Looks like some o' those thievin' Bilge rats have beaten ye t' it...
text.hint.101.0: Hey, what be ye doin'? Arr, matey!
text.hint.101.1: Call yerself a matey? Since when do hearties use each other fer target practice?
text.hint.102.0: Show me th' invasion... Blow me down!
text.hint.103.1: Ye be now in possession o' th' Red Skeleton key.
text.hint.103.2: Astonishingly, this can be used t' open hatches wit' red locks. Yo ho!
text.hint.104.1: I must be goin'. Goodbye. Shiver me timbers!
text.hint.105.1: Here ye go--one Tri-Rocket Launcher. Make some noise. Arr, matey!
text.hint.106.1: Show me what happened. Blow me down!
text.hint.106.2: I'll leave ye t' yer thoughts.
